name: Subgroup
description: Allows you to structure groups into a hierarchical tree with permissions inheriting up or down
project_description:
This module is an extension to the Group module that allows you to set up a hierarchy of groups, with permissions inheriting up or down the tree.

 It's designed like the Group module in a sense that you configure your set-up once and then all groups behave according to these rules.

 Instructions 
 
 Download and install the module (and its dependencies) 
 Go to admin/group/subgroup 
 Set up a tree structure and inheritances 
 Enjoy your Subgroup functionality! 
 
 Special note 
 
 The initial release requires you to set up your tree (almost) from scratch. There are limitations to what you can do on websites with existing groups. 
 The UI was not the main recipient of the development budget, so improvements could be needed in that area
